Dates of moving holidays in Indonesia

Source: R/holidays.R
holiday_dates.Rd

Dates of Eid al-Adha (Idul Adha), Eid al-Fitr (Idul Fitri) and the Chinese New Year (Imlek) as observed in Indonesia, 2004--2027. The Islamic dates are those decided by the Government of Indonesia after the official moon sighting (sidang isbat); both 2006 Eid al-Adha occurrences (10 January and 31 December) are included. The 2027 Islamic dates follow the joint ministerial decree (SKB) and may move by one day after the moon sighting. For other holidays or countries, pass your own vector of dates to [lunarcast()].

Usage

holiday_dates(holiday = c("idul_adha", "idul_fitri", "imlek"))

Arguments

holiday

One of `"idul_adha"`, `"idul_fitri"` or `"imlek"`.

Value

A sorted `Date` vector.

See also

[easter_dates()] for Easter-based holidays and [holiday_window()] to turn dates into regressors.

Examples

holiday_dates("idul_adha")
#>  [1] "2004-02-01" "2005-01-21" "2006-01-10" "2006-12-31" "2007-12-20"
#>  [6] "2008-12-08" "2009-11-27" "2010-11-17" "2011-11-06" "2012-10-26"
#> [11] "2013-10-15" "2014-10-05" "2015-09-24" "2016-09-12" "2017-09-01"
#> [16] "2018-08-22" "2019-08-11" "2020-07-31" "2021-07-20" "2022-07-10"
#> [21] "2023-06-29" "2024-06-17" "2025-06-06" "2026-05-27" "2027-05-17"
# Eid al-Adha moves about 11 days earlier every year
diff(holiday_dates("idul_adha"))
#> Time differences in days
#>  [1] 355 354 355 354 354 354 355 354 355 354 355 354 354 354 355 354 355 354 355
#> [20] 354 354 354 355 355
